CustomField.description: Routed outcome of SupportDraftOrchestrator for this Case. DRAFTED = a reviewable draft was produced; ESCALATE = top match is escalate-only, no draft. NO_DRAFT_* = no draft, route to a human (reason in AI_Draft_Notes__c): NO_DRAFT_NO_MATCH (no usable solution), NO_DRAFT_EXCLUDED (intake-excluded), NO_DRAFT_LOW_CONFIDENCE (model declined or retrieval below the drafting floor), NO_DRAFT_UNGROUNDED (draft claims did not trace to cited sources - aggregate grounding or the deterministic per-claim fabrication check), NO_DRAFT_UNVERIFIED (draft passed grounding but the second-model verification gate did not confirm it answers the specific question using only supported claims; fail-closed), NO_DRAFT_MODEL_ERROR (empty/garbled/unparseable response after retries). NO_DRAFT_ERROR is legacy, retained for historical records. Stamped by the AutomatedEmailDrafting flow.
CustomField.label: AI Draft Status
